$root.$description: (motion.ts MOTION has the same values; a test keeps them equal) exit: something leaving, and quick pops in. change: a state changing (a ring, a size). slow: an indicator (a progress, a dot). glide: something moving (below).

note.$description: How long a passing note stays before it has faded out (LiveBadge's "typed from iPhone"). Not a motion: reduced motion keeps it.

$root.$description: Moving a window or a view: a critically damped spring (no bounce) sampled for CSS, the curve the app's TileMotion runs in JS (apps/desktop motion.ts, GLIDE_MS).
